lineage: NEW. Not a variant of EXP-ARP-008: there is no directional signal at all. Exposure is a deterministic function of realized volatility only.
mechanism_statement: Hold a fixed BTC/ETH/SOL equal-weight basket continuously, scaled by a target-volatility overlay (target_vol / realized_vol, capped to [0,1]). The mechanism is risk scaling, not return prediction.

rules.exposure: w_t = min(1, target_vol / realized_vol_t) with realized_vol_t = 20-day population stdev of basket daily log returns
rules.rebalance: weekly at UTC close; act next open
rules.position: long-only basket weight w_t; fixed base notional 500 USD; no compounding

spec_contract.entry_rule: continuous long basket; exposure w=min(1, target_vol/realized_vol), weekly
spec_contract.exit_rule: continuous; no directional exit; weight may fall to 0 only if realized_vol explodes

implementation_config.entry_rule: continuous long basket; exposure w=min(1, target_vol/realized_vol), weekly
implementation_config.exit_rule: continuous; no directional exit; weight may fall to 0 only if realized_vol explodes
implementation_config.disposition: NOT_IMPLEMENTED — pre-registration only; no DEV execution in ARP-008

kill_criteria: DEV gross expectancy <= cost bps -> REJECT_COSTS
single trade > 50% of positive DEV net -> REJECT_FRAGILE

gates.promotion: positive net DEV AND positive net VALIDATION AND cost PASS AND robustness PASS AND PIT PASS AND contract PASS AND sample sufficient AND concentration acceptable AND builder != verifier
